batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2021-2022, Set-F — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.51-54 (questions; printed answer table on p.54; printed worked solutions pp.54-56). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED; cross-source verification is a separate later stage. Printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is; they are NOT official JU keys. Printed subject order in this set: Bangla (Q1-3), English (Q4-6), ICT (Q7-14), Physics (Q15-36), Higher Mathematics (Q37-58), Chemistry (Q59-80) — note that Higher Mathematics precedes Chemistry in the printed order of this set. The printed answer table has dashes (no key) at Q7 and Q71; the printed worked solutions for both (Q7 on p.54, Q71 on p.56) explicitly state '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' (no correct answer), so both are recorded with answerDisposition no_correct_option and empty correctOptionIds; for these two questions only, answerVerificationStatus is set to 'verified' solely as the validator-required encoding of the primary source's own explicit printed claim — it does NOT denote cross-source verification, which remains a later stage for the whole paper. Q10 carries an internal source contradiction: the table keys (c) but the printed worked solution (p.54) states no correct option exists — the table key is recorded and the contradiction documented in the question's extractionNote. Q25 option (a) is printed as a 14-digit string while the book's own solution computes a 12-digit value — transcribed as printed. No dual keys appear in the printed table. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
